name: shelf
description: Index local and GitHub repositories with a one-line description of each, and look them up by name or topic. Reads files only and never runs anything inside a repository. Queries need an index from a previous shelf scan. Partial community schema covering the lookup and description commands.

global_args.name: --output
global_args.description: Output format; auto is JSON when piped.

commands.name: search
commands.description: Find indexed repositories by name, description, topic, or language. Every word must match.

output_fields.name: items
output_fields.description: Matching repositories with id, name, path, remote, and description.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show one repository: path, remote, branch, language, manifests, and agent files such as AGENTS.md.

commands.name: list
commands.description: List indexed repositories with their descriptions.

commands.name: describe
commands.description: Set or clear a repository's description override in the Shelf configuration. Overrides are keyed by remote and survive rescans.
examples: shelf describe delta "Payments service for the web app"

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Rebuild the index from local roots and GitHub owners, saving any roots or owners given. GitHub listing goes through gh.

args.name: --root
args.description: Directory to search for Git repositories; repeatable.
